items.hed: Texans play Jacksonville in London on Sunday, 8:30 a.m. Central
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Oct. 18, as an away game against the Jacksonville Jaguars at Wembley Stadium, kickoff 8:30 a.m. Central, on NFL Network. No score is printed here because Sunday has not been played.

items.hed: Astros are out; Cleveland leads Tampa Bay 2-1 heading into Game 4 tonight
items.insight: MLB.com's postseason schedule lists the Brewers, who swept Los Angeles, and the Rays and Guardians in the League Championship Series. Houston is not on that list. Thursday's line reads Cleveland 3, Tampa Bay 2, Cleveland leads 2-1. Game 4, Tampa Bay at Cleveland, is Friday at 8 p.m. Eastern on TBS, truTV, HBO Max, and UniMas. Milwaukee won the National League series 4-0.

items.hed: Rockets open at home against Dallas on Oct. 21, 7:30 p.m.
items.insight: The Rockets' schedule announcement lists Opening Night Presented by Toyota against Dallas on Oct. 21, with standard home tipoffs at 7:30 p.m. The same release says the club played preseason games against Dallas in Macao on Oct. 9 and Oct. 11. No regular-season score is printed here because the opener has not been played.
